generationRequest.prompt: Use case: edit reference background into ONE isolated transparent FAR ORGAN PARALLAX LAYER for a 2D side-scrolling underwater game inside a dead whale. Preserve reference matte painted gouache style and organ identity. Output landscape16:9 canvas, keep original 1672x941 aspect and composition anchors. This layer contains only 1 or 2 broad perimeter anatomical contours as a single layer, with a large completely transparent center and lower center for gameplay. REMOVE ALL blue water, water rays, bubbles, specks, haze, background wash, floor platforms, near framing, creatures and all props. All empty areas must have genuine zero-alpha transparency, no blue rectangle, no checker pattern. Keep far anatomy muted cool low contrast with soft internal shading but a clean external alpha edge. No bright top ledges that read as gameplay terrain, no cropped gameplay modules. Depict only the following far organ forms: Dead whale upper palate roof and distant oral wall rim mostly along TOP and upper RIGHT, subtle coarse organic ridges in muted indigo-blue. A few short very distant baleen hints only integrated into upper roof, do not make a dense curtain; near baleen is a separate sprite. At least middle60% and bottom50% of canvas entirely empty transparent. No tongue or platforms. Do not retain the water lighting.
